AbstractText.Label: OBJECTIVES
AbstractText.content: To compare "Early Total Care" (ETC) with "Staged Protocol" (SP) for the treatment of Schatzker IV-VI tibial plateau fractures in patients older than 50 years regarding safety and effectiveness.

AbstractText.Label: SETTING
AbstractText.content: An academic level 1 US trauma center.

AbstractText.Label: PATIENTS/PARTICIPANTS
AbstractText.content: Eighty-one patients older than 50 years with Schatzker grade IV-VI tibial plateau fractures were included.

AbstractText.Label: INTERVENTION
AbstractText.content: Fifty-three patients were treated under SP with immediate external fixation followed by definitive internal fixation. Twenty-eight patients were treated under ETC with immediate internal fixation.

AbstractText.Label: MAIN OUTCOME MEASUREMENTS
AbstractText.content: Comparison of perioperative findings, time to bony and clinical union, soft-tissue and bony complications, radiological outcome, and secondary procedures.

AbstractText.Label: RESULTS
AbstractText.content: The 2 groups were comparable without significant difference regarding age, sex, side of involvement, body mass index, smoking status, American Society of Anesthesiologist classification, associated injuries, comorbidities, follow-up duration, and fracture classification. No statistically significant difference was found regarding the perioperative complications, quality of reduction, time to union, Rasmussen score at union or at the final follow-up, soft-tissue/bony complications, and the rate of the secondary procedures.

AbstractText.Label: CONCLUSION
AbstractText.content: ETC seems to be a safe, efficacious, and effective alternative to the SP for the treatment of some Schatzker IV-VI fractures in patients older than 50 years.

AbstractText.Label: LEVEL OF EVIDENCE
AbstractText.content: Therapeutic Level III. See Instructions for Authors for a complete description of levels of evidence.

Article.ArticleTitle: Is "Early Total Care" a Safe and Effective Alternative to "Staged Protocol" for the Treatment of Schatzker IV-VI Tibial Plateau Fractures in Patients Older Than 50 Years?
